The '''Ashash system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Zarracina sector/Legends|Zarracina sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ashash]].
